method: Area websites, newsletters, minutes and election announcements searched 2026-10-19 and rechecked 2026-11-23 and 2026-11-24 (area sites, district and intergroup newsletters and minutes, regional sources). Names reduced to first name + last initial.

areas.notes: As of Nov 24, 2026: Elections were scheduled for Sat Oct 10 at the Oct 9–11 assembly in Birmingham and almost certainly took place, but no public source names the Panel 77 delegate or alternate. The likeliest next source is the November issue of District 14's ODAAT newsletter, which reported the area election in 2022.

Source: the Arkansas Central Office (Little Rock) 'Nameless Newsletter', Fall 2026, p. 6, whose Area Assembly recap has a box of 'Area 4 Election Results (for 2027-2028 rotation)': Delegate Jason C. (the Panel 75 alternate) and Alternate Delegate Bryan R. (the Panel 75 co-chair). The vote was in the Sunday business session of the Oct 3-4 Fall Assembly in Russellville. arkansasaa.org itself still posts no results.

Source: the home page of District 3, Area 05 (Pasadena), which lists the new Area officers 'elected at the last Area Assembly': Delegate Gola and Alternate Delegate Zoraida; the last initials come from the SCAAN Fall 2026 newsletter linked from area05aa.org. Gola R. was the Panel 75 alternate. Election assembly Oct 18, 2026.

Verified. The Chair's preview in the November 2026 CNCA Comments newsletter (CNCA 06, Area 06), written by Drew B. as CNCA Chair, reads: 'Last Saturday, we had our final Assembly of Panel 75, in where we picked our Officers for Panel 77', followed by 'Delegate: Drew B.' and 'Alternate Delegate: Dan B.' The Panel 77 Chair is Claudia N., the P75 alternate. The newsletter gives no calendar date. The Nov 14, 2026 date comes from the October 2026 newsletter's listing of the Fall Election Assembly, which fits 'last Saturday'. The P75 delegate was Chitra S., so Drew B. is a new delegate, not a holdover.

As of Nov 24, 2026: Elections were on the agenda of the Sat Nov 7 Winter Assembly at the DoubleTree in Greenwood Village, but no public source yet names the Panel 77 delegate or alternate. Results may appear in the December issues of Denver's Last Drop or Boulder's The Message, or in Winter Assembly minutes on coloradoaa.org.

As of Nov 24, 2026: Officers were to be elected at the Nov 7 Fall Voting Assembly in Wethersfield (plus Zoom); no public source yet names the Panel 77 delegate or alternate. In 2024 the November Delegate's Report named the incoming officers, so the November 2026 report on ct-aa.org, expected late Nov or early Dec, should too.

Verified from the PDF text of the WAIA (DC intergroup) board draft minutes of 11/10/2026, section 'Washington Area General Service Assembly (WAGSA) Area 13 Liaison Report'. It says: 'On October 18, WAGSA GSRs, DCMs and Officers filled five positions for the next two years: Delegate: Kesi L, who currently serves as Alternate Delegate; Alternate Delegate: Joni D., current WAGSA/WAIA liaison'. 'Next two years' (volunteers for 2027-2028) = Panel 77. The source is a secondary, draft document; the Area 13 site is not yet updated.

Area 14's October 2026 assembly minutes (p. 22) list the Panel 77 officers elected at the Third Legacy voting meeting on Sunday, Oct 4, 2026: Delegate Nicole D., Alternate Delegate Pete W. This is the new panel, not Panel 75, whose delegate is Lori P.; the Panel 75 alternate, who signs her reports Nicole D., is likely the same person.

The Area 15 October 2026 'Early Bird Minutes' (posted 2026-10-07) list the Panel 77 Election Results: Delegate Donna W.; Alternate Delegate Bron F.; Area Chairperson Alan T.; Treasurer Tom S.; Registrar Paul M.; Recording Secretary Debbie C. The election was held at the Oct 2-4, 2026 General Service Assembly at the Westin Cape Coral. The program (https://area15aa.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/2026-OCT-Program-Westin-Cape-Coral-Final.pdf) lists the 'Panel 77 Trusted Servant Election' on Sunday Oct 4 after the 9:00am Business Meeting. Under current practice the Alternate Delegate also chairs the State Convention committee.

The What-To-Take-Back sheet for the 'Elections Assembly November 7-8, 2026' (PDF text extracted and read) says: 'Area 17, Panel 77 Area Officers: Delegate- Sean F., Alt. Delegate- Deborah L'. The Panel 75 officers were Delegate Deborah S. and Alternate Sean F., so Sean F. moves up from alternate. The new Chair is Sean C.

As of Nov 24, 2026: The area website could not be read, and no other public source gives the Panel 77 election date or result. Public event listings show a Chicago Area Service Assembly (CASA) on Sat Nov 21, hosted by District 12, but not whether it held the delegate election; the Panel 75 delegate is Robert J.

As of Nov 24, 2026: The Panel 77 officer election assembly was held Sept 13 in Vandalia, but no public source names the delegate or alternate. September minutes are normally approved at the next assembly, Dec 13 in Edwardsville, so results may surface in its agenda or minutes, which District 11 usually reposts.

As of Nov 24, 2026: The Election Assembly was held Oct 11 at Twelve Mile Community Center, but area22indiana.org still lists Panel 75 delegate Karin O. Minutes are posted only after the next assembly approves them, so the election minutes, likely approved Nov 22 in Fort Wayne, may appear in the coming weeks or months.

Source: public minutes of the Nov 1, 2026 District 9 meeting (Quad Cities, Iowa), where the DCM's report on the Area 24 Fall Conference (Oct 16-18, Cedar Falls) lists the newly elected area officers: Delegate Nate W.; the alternate delegate is given only as Beth (no initial). The elections were in the Saturday Oct 17 business meeting. aa-iowa.org publishes no officer names.

As of Nov 24, 2026: The Aug 15–16 Q3 assembly in Alexandria was the election assembly, and a late-August call for 2027–28 committee chairs indicates it took place. The area website does not print officer names; the Jan 16–17, 2027 Baton Rouge assembly materials or a district Delegate's Report flyer are the likeliest sources.

Source: 'GENERAL SERVICE COMMITTEE OF EASTERN MASSACHUSETTS | AREA 30 November 2026 Election Assembly Minutes', Nov 1, 2026, marked DRAFT - PENDING APPROVAL. The original link (1kpE9...) is a Drive shortcut owned by the aaemass.org alt chair, and this URL is its target PDF. 'Panel 77 Area Officers: DELEGATE Virginia M., ALTERNATE DELEGATE Joe R.' Virginia M. (Panel 75 Alternate Delegate) was elected on the 2nd ballot, and Joe R. (Panel 75 Area Chair) was elected Alternate by acclamation. No one stood for Northeast Regional Trustee nominee.

As of Nov 24, 2026: Per the handbook, the delegate and alternate were to be elected at the Oct 4 assembly at Somerset Beach Campground, Jerome; no result is public, and cmia32.org still lists Panel 75 delegate Jon S. The next assembly, where the other officers are elected, is Dec 6 in Essexville.

As of Nov 24, 2026: Officers are elected at the October Election Assembly in even years (Oct 18 this year), but no public source names the Panel 77 delegate; aa-semi.org still lists Panel 75 delegate Cheryl B. and alternate Edgar L. Minutes or news may follow the next assembly, Dec 13 at Madison High School.

As of Nov 24, 2026: The election assembly was held Oct 17 at Jordan Community Center; District 22's November minutes confirm new officers were elected but do not name them. The likeliest sources are the December issue of the quarterly Pigeon newsletter and the Dec 9 officers transition meeting.

Verified by downloading the public Drive PDF 'Area 38 Fall Assembly, October 3rd & 4th, 2026 ... Summary of Actions'. It says: 'Laura S. was elected Panel 77 Delegate on the second ballot' (59 votes) and 'Rob W. was elected Panel 77 Alternate Delegate on the first ballot' ('exactly two-thirds'). Laura S. was the Panel 75 Alternate. Elections were on Sunday Oct 4 per the assembly agenda.

As of Nov 24, 2026: Elections were held Sun Sept 20 at the Sept 19–20 assembly in Sedalia, but the area website still lists Panel 75 delegate Greg G. and alternate Jon M. The likeliest next source is the Jan 16–17, 2027 assembly materials or an update to the About Area 39 and Delegate's Corner pages.

District 61 (Helena) business meeting minutes of Oct 1, 2026, posted on the area website, contain this DCM report: 'we did elect a new slate of Area officers... congrats to Jessica EW from Kalispell who was elected to be our new delegate.' Recorded as first name plus last initial; the agenda prints her as 'Jessica E. W.', and she was the Panel 75-term Area Chair. The Fall Assembly agenda (https://www.aa-montana.org/pdf/area/2026FallAssemblyAgenda.pdf) put the 'Area 40 Elections' on Saturday Sept 26, 1:30-3:30 pm, for Delegate, Area Chair/Alternate Delegate, Treasurer and Secretary. In Area 40 the alternate delegate is the combined Area Chair/Alternate Delegate seat, and no published source names who won it, so the alternate is left null. The source is a district report, not area minutes; the Fall 2026 assembly minutes are not posted yet.

Elected at the Area 42 election assembly (Sept 11-13, 2026, Tonopah; Panel 77 elections began Sat Sept 12). The area website had not posted results as of 2026-10-19; the source URL is the assembly agenda. Alternate not known.

As of Nov 24, 2026: The Oct 17 election assembly took place; the November Intergroup News N Notes says the elections are complete but refers readers to assembly handouts that are not online. The Winter 2026 issue of the area newsletter This Day, expected around December, is the likeliest next source.

The Area 47 minutes of the September 13, 2026 assembly (Syracuse NY and online) have an 'AREA ELECTIONS - PANEL 77' section, moderated by past delegate Christopher M. Results: Delegate Liza C. (Canandaigua); Alternate Delegate Brian M. (Rochester); Area Chairperson Bonnie G.; Treasurer Greg K.; Registrar Franklin H.; Recording Secretary Katherine W. The Secretary-elect resigned and that seat goes to a Third Legacy vote at the next assembly. The outgoing Panel 75 delegate is Cindy D. The minutes are pending approval at the October assembly.

Verified from the PDF text of the 'SENY Assembly Minutes, September 19th, 2026', section 'Panel 77 Area 49 Elections': 'Jeannie B. was elected as Panel 77 Delegate with substantial unanimity.' and 'Justin K. was elected at Panel 77 Alternate Delegate with substantial unanimity.' Also elected: Area Chair Shawn K. and Treasurer Mike O. Tech Officer and Registration Officer were left OPEN for a November special election. Correction to the earlier note: these minutes list the P75 Alternate Delegate as Jeanne C., so Jeannie B. has a different last initial and should not be assumed to be the P75 alternate. Justin K. was the P75 Registration Officer.

As of Nov 24, 2026: The Nov 7–8 Fall Election Assembly took place (District 23 minutes report 346 attending), but no public source names the Panel 77 delegate or alternate. The December Beaming Beacon delegate newsletter, usually posted in the first week of the month, is the likeliest next source.

As of Nov 24, 2026: The Sept 12 Fall Assembly at the Ramada Inn in Fargo had an Elections item, and the panel rotation points to a Panel 77 delegate vote, but no public source confirms the result. The area's service documents are password-protected, and nothing posted since names a delegate-elect.

An Area 53 news post, 'Panel 77 Election Results' (Sept 15, 2026), lists Panel 77 officers serving 2027-2028: Delegate Marcia H.; Alternate Delegate Tommy O.; Chair Kyle M.; Alt Chair Jenniffer R.; Treasurer Maria C.; Alt Treasurer James G.; Secretary Mela K.; Alt Secretary Erin P.; Registrar Kari B.; Alt Registrar Dave H. The Area 53 events calendar lists the 'Area 53 Elections Assembly (Panel 77)' on Sept 13, 2026 at 10:00am (https://area53aa.org/event/area-53-elections-assembly-panel-77/).

Verified from the PDF text of the Northeast Ohio Area 54 Recorder, November-December 2026 Edition, Volume XIX, Issue 7. It says: 'At the October Assembly, we held our elections for Panel 77. These are your new officers and trusted servants: Katie S., Delegate ... Jeff C., Alternate Delegate'. Beverly F. / Wellington R. are named as the outgoing Panel 75 Delegate and Alternate. The Oct 18 assembly date comes from the Sept 20 minutes and the 2026 trifold.

As of Nov 24, 2026: The Sept 13 Annual Assembly at Embassy Suites OU Med Center, Oklahoma City, was the election assembly and very likely held the vote, but no public source names the Panel 77 delegate. Likely next sources are a September or December Area 57 newsletter, or the area website after the Dec 6 quarterly meeting.

Minutes of the 69th Annual EPGSA Convention & Assembly (Nov 14, 2026, Lancaster; EPGSA = Area 59), PDF text extracted and read: 'Panel 77 Officer Elections ... Delegate: Alex N., Alternate Delegate: Tara C.' Tara C. chaired as the Panel 75 Chairperson, and Alex N. was the Panel 75 alternate. Other new officers: Chair Lauren B. and Secretary Jen F.

Source: 'The 23 Informer', November 2026 newsletter of District 23 (Greensburg), Area 60 News: the Panel 77 officers elected at the Oct 4, 2026 Election Assembly in Pittsburgh include Delegate Tami D. and Alternate Delegate Marcia W. Mario D. remains the Panel 75 delegate through 2026.
Elected at the NETA 65 fall election assembly (Sept 18-20, 2026).

Elected at the SETA General Assembly - Elections (Saturday, October 3, 2026, hybrid). The area website had not posted results as of 2026-10-19; the source URL is the home page that lists the election assembly. Alternate not known.

Elected at the Area 69 Fall Assembly Elections (Sept 25-27, 2026, District 3, Kamas). The area website had not posted results as of 2026-10-19; the source URL is the Area 69 Calendar of Events PDF that lists the election assembly (linked from https://sites.google.com/aaofutah.org/aa-of-utah/area-69-events). Alternate not known.

Source: public minutes of the Oct 21, 2026 Virginia District 30 (Fredericksburg) meeting; the DCM's report on the VAC Fall Assembly (Oct 16-18, Falls Church) lists 'Panel 77 Officers (2027-2028)': Delegate Dave H., Alternate Delegate Stefanie C.

Source is the official 'Western Washington Area 72 October 2026 Assembly Business Meeting Minutes' (Little Creek Casino, Shelton WA, Oct 3-4, 2026), linked from the District 46 site's Area 72 page. area72aa.org refused connections from here (ECONNREFUSED). Elections are the first business in the minutes, so 2026-10-03 is inferred as the day. Delegate: Lupita (printed as 'Lupita YM', recorded here as 'Lupita Y.'), current Alternate Delegate, elected on the 3rd ballot under Third Legacy with two-thirds against Jennifer R. Alternate Delegate: Derek S., current Area Chair, chosen by lot ('the hat') after 4 ballots against Jennifer. Other officers elected: Chair Lisa S., Alt Chair Jennifer R., Treasurer Eddy M-M. The area newsletter (news.area72aa.org) post-assembly articles are members-only.

As of Nov 24, 2026: Panel 77 elections were scheduled for Sept 12 at the Sept 11–13 Fall Assembly in Elkins; no public source names the results, and the November area newsletter has none. Likely next sources are a December area newsletter, District 11's November minutes, or the Mar 19–21, 2027 Spring Assembly materials.

As of Nov 24, 2026: Officer elections were scheduled for the Sat Nov 7 Service Assembly at the Area 75 Conference (Ingleside Hotel, Pewaukee); no result has been published. The Jan/Feb 2027 Area 75 Grapevine/La Viña newsletter or the Jan 17, 2027 Winter Service Assembly materials are the likeliest next sources.

Source: the District 4 (Comox Valley) DCM's monthly report for November 2026: 'The results of the Panel 77 election' at the Area 79 voting assembly in Port Alberni (Oct 24, 2026): Delegate Paul T., Alternate Delegate Joanne C.

As of Nov 24, 2026: Elections were almost certainly held Oct 10 at the Fall Assembly in Corner Brook; Oct 25 minutes call it the outgoing delegate's last Area Officer/DCM meeting but name no successor. Last year the Fall Assembly minutes were posted Dec 15, so the names will likely appear around mid-December.

As of Nov 24, 2026: Panel 77 officers were to be elected Nov 1 at the Fall Assembly in Kingston, and Ottawa Intergroup minutes imply the vote took place; the area's results post appears to be members-only. Likely public sources are the Toronto (GTA) Intergroup minutes or Ottawa's December Our Primary Purpose.

As of Nov 24, 2026: No fall 2026 assembly date or Panel 77 result has been published; the area assembly meets each spring and fall, and a fall 2026 delegate election is likely but unconfirmed. The area website, rarely updated, still lists Panel 75 delegate Joel C.

As of Nov 24, 2026: The annual general assembly (AGA) was held Nov 14 at Cap-St-Ignace; by the 2024 precedent it elected the Panel 77 delegate and alternate, but no result is posted. In 2025 the AGA minutes went online 8 days later, so they may appear on aaregion88.org in early December.

As of Nov 24, 2026: Elections were set for the Oct 3 general assembly; the region says the new executive will be introduced in the Dec–Jan Nordet, expected early December. The Dec 5 regional assembly in St-Augustin-de-Desmaures will also welcome the new trusted servants.

As of Nov 24, 2026: The Election Assembly was held the Oct 16–18 weekend in Meadow Lake, as the Area 78 delegate's November report confirms, but no public source names the Panel 77 delegate or alternate. The area website still lists Panel 75 delegate Alison G. and alternate Jim J.

As of Nov 24, 2026: Elections were scheduled for the Nov 14–15 Area Assembly at Veterans Hall, Morro Bay; no result is posted, and area93.org still lists Panel 75 delegate Rudy M. After the 2024 election the officer list was updated in late January, so results will likely appear around January 2027.
